summary: Pet Moods, Companions, Codex, Expeditions, and Souvenirs features tested successfully. Backend: 21/21 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI screens verified - PetDisplay with mood/voice lines, Pet Codex with pets/companions tabs, Companions screen with unlock progress, Souvenirs screen with rarity filters, and Expedition Modal after 20+ minute sessions. Fixed 2 bugs in expedition-reward endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pet features fully tested. User has pet 'Inferno' (Blaze dragon) at Stage 1 with 100% happiness. Mood shows 'ecstatic' with contextual voice lines. Codex shows 1/17 pets owned, 0/13 companions. Companions screen shows progress toward unlocking (e.g., 7/25 for habit-based companions). Souvenirs screen shows empty state with helpful message. Expedition modal triggers after 20+ minute sessions and awards coins/XP with random chance for souvenir items.

bugs_fixed.issue: expedition-reward endpoint was looking for 'duration_minutes' field but sessions use 'minutes_spent'
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed field name from 'duration_minutes' to 'minutes_spent' in the query

bugs_fixed.issue: expedition-reward endpoint was looking for 'logged_at' field but sessions use 'timestamp'
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed field name from 'logged_at' to 'timestamp' in the query

pet_mood_voice_lines.details: Returns mood level (ecstatic/happy/content/bored/sad/lonely), icon, color, happiness %, and contextual voice line based on time of day and streak milestones

pet_codex.details: Returns pets (17 total), companions (13 total), accessories with owned status and completion percentage (1% for test user)

companions.details: Returns 13 companions with unlock progress, rarity, bonuses. Supports activate/deactivate endpoints

souvenirs.details: Returns collected souvenirs grouped by rarity (legendary/rare/uncommon/common)

expedition_reward.details: Awards coins/XP and random souvenir items after 20+ minute sessions. Rarity based on session duration (25-39min=uncommon, 40-59min=rare, 60+min=legendary)

frontend_pet_display.details: Shows pet icon, name, rarity, happiness bar, evolution progress, mood section with voice line, active companion, and navigation buttons (Codex, Companions, Souvenirs)

frontend_pet_codex.details: Shows overall completion, Pets tab (grid with owned/locked status), Companions tab (list with unlock hints)

frontend_companions.details: Shows collection stats, companion list with rarity badges, unlock progress bars, activate/deactivate buttons

frontend_souvenirs.details: Shows total collected, rarity breakdown, filter buttons (All/Legendary/Rare/Uncommon/Common), empty state with helpful message

frontend_expedition_modal.details: Shows expedition name, story, rewards (coins/XP), souvenir item if found, animated particles, close button
